name: sitebrew
description: Make a website from a short conversation: Sitebrew turns a few answers into three site candidates to compare, then revises and delivers the one you pick. It includes web-factory (a shadcn registry and site-stamping pipeline) and launch-factory (auth, billing, email and analytics back end) at one pinned release tag. Works without any API key in preview mode.

PEXELS_API_KEY.title: Pexels API key (optional)
PEXELS_API_KEY.description: Free key from pexels.com/api. Leave empty to build sites in preview mode: stock photo slots stay as image-in-progress placeholders.

LAW_API_OC.title: Korean law API ID, LAW_API_OC (optional)
LAW_API_OC.description: OC id from an Open API request at open.law.go.kr. Leave empty to build sites in preview mode: legal pages stay unverified and cannot be published.

VERCEL_TOKEN.title: Vercel token (optional)
VERCEL_TOKEN.description: Only for online preview links (--deploy-preview). Leave empty if you use vercel login or do not need a preview link.

HIGGSFIELD_DIR.title: Generated-image folder (optional)
HIGGSFIELD_DIR.description: A folder of images you generated yourself. Leave empty and generated-image slots are written to higgsfield.request.json as requests.
